profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Docusign
profile.summary: I am a highly motivated software engineer with excellent leadership and programming skills, and a strong will to carry any project to the finish line no matter how hard it is.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop complex front end UI
- Handle build and deep webpack integration points and plugins

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Serve as technical lead for a scrum team and collaborate with stakeholders and PO to break down complex requirements into small demonstrable user workflow stories, then design and develop JAVA REST backend services and Angular UI to support those stories.

Refactored and increased Python test automation passing rate from 20% to 100% for BIG-IQ management system core module code.

Developed NPM Node package to quickly validate UI changes in CI/CD pipeline against custom schemas

Mentor new members and help set direction for team and received multiple F5 Shout Out awards and one BeF5 award

Resigned to pursue project/start-up after wrapping up 3 big initiatives - Waterfall to Agile, Angular to React and Monolith to Microservice

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Full Stack
positions.description:
* Served as technical lead and scrum master for the team
* Solved complex on the spot customer issues and wrote Node JS scripts for work around when necessary
* Developed complex SPA UI with Angular, HTML, CSS, LESS, Javascript, Jasmine and Gulp
* Developed JAVA REST API on the backend to support complex business logic
* Architected and developed data driven UI which reduced dev time for UI pages from days to just hours
* Prototyped and demo web app written in Go and React that can quickly configure new BIG-IPs for tests

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Front End
positions.description:
* Developed complex business logic web pages using AngularJs for BIG-IQ Device Management System
* Created a dev box tool using shell script and Vagrant which dramatically reduce dev time for team members 
* Developed API and UI test automation using Python Selenium and Python NOSE testing framework

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Developed and helped architect multiple clients for device and data management systems using cross platform codes to build and run on Android, Linux X86, Window XP X86 and Window Mobile
* Developed Android Apps and used Java Native Interface to port C++ source codes from WM 6 to Android
* Actively helped define requirements, and break them into features for Agile Sprint Planning
* Lead efforts to standardize software reuse across the organization as a Sig Sigma Green Belt Project
* Work with and lead team members all across the world, include New Zealand, Prague and India
* Champion changes and actively contribute to integration efforts when Honeywell acquired Intermec

positions.title: Software Eng I
positions.description:
* Developed tools directly for customers using C# to promote and secure many sale deals both big and small   
* Developed web applications using HTML5, Javascript, JQuery Add WM 6 support to a large open source test framework called Linaro Automation Validation Architecture
* Trained customers on site and product support engineers off site about to use our device management system
* Organized, update, and maintain software documents for current and past software projects

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
* Solved many customer issues including critical ones that helped secured large and small contracts
* Create test plans, write test cases and train new testers
* Execute test cases, log and track bugs through different stages in IBM Rational ClearQuest System 
* Write test automations in Python and act as the Point Of Contact for Continuous Integration efforts

positions.title: Sr. Undergrad in Computer Science and Communication
positions.description:
Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science completion date: 12/2010
Minor in Communication with Emphasis on Advertising completion date:  12/2010

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Gather requirements from customers and create software design document.  Develop software testing tools in C++.  Maintain and update software design documents.

projects.title: Yumbo
projects.description: Web app that combines recipes, nutrients and health, built with Nextjs/Nodejs, React, Typescript, Jest, and Playwright, PosgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, Terraform, AWS, Cloudfront, S3
